  "pros": [
    "The software is easy to use, which helps their team manage web-based customer service efficiently.",
    "It allows customers to submit detailed issues, including screenshots, improving communication.",
    "The integration with other Zoho products streamlines their overall business operations."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "The software can be slow at times, impacting response times for customer service agents.",
    "They noted a lack of custom modules to tailor the system to their specific needs.",
    "The live chat saving feature needs improvement for better traceability of conversations."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Customer Service Manager generally had a positive experience with Zoho Desk, finding it user-friendly and effective for managing their web-based customer service applications. They appreciated its ability to handle detailed customer issues and its integration capabilities. However, occasional performance issues and limitations in customization and live chat traceability were noted frustrations."
